Hi Jonas,

We just self-signed up and booked a demo slot for Redwood Dedicated next week. Thanks for making the quick flow — excited to talk through Dedicated options. High-level details so you have context ahead of the call:

- Expected steady-state throughput: ~120 QPS
- Bursts: up to 450 QPS for ~5–10 minute windows (batching at app-level)
- Typical prompt: ~350–500 tokens; average response ~180 tokens
- p95 latency target: <200ms for interactive endpoints

I've attached a short capacity requirements doc (gridlytics_capacity_requirements.pdf) with a sample prompt set.

Please loop in the right folks for a technical intake (ops/solutions). Our procurement team may want a brief note about SLA/uptime and data isolation; happy to share details during the call.

Arielle — thanks, and great to meet you (virtually). Moving to 15:00–15:30 PST Tue 2026-06-30 works for our team; calendar invite sent.

Short answers up front: yes, we fully support a staged canary that pins a percentage of traffic to a Dedicated pool. For your use case we'd recommend the following canary playbook:

- Canary window: 2 hours (start-of-day low-traffic preferred)
- Traffic split: 20% to Dedicated pool, 80% to existing hosted endpoints
- Hard caps: set Dedicated autoscale ceiling to 600 QPS during canary to prevent cost runaway
- SLO targets: p95 latency <200ms; if p95 >300ms for 5 consecutive minutes, automated rollback to hosted
- Observability: we'll share dashboards in the Console and enable token-level latency/cost breakdowns for the canary window

Prep we need from GridLytics before the canary:
1) Sample traffic S3 link (anonymized prompts + token counts) — to validate batching and KV cache hit expectations
2) Short list of representative endpoints + expected concurrency per endpoint
3) Preferred region (you already indicated us-west-2 — good)
4) Mutual Action Plan sign-off (we have a short doc; link in calendar invite)

We can also provision a VPC-isolated Dedicated pool for the canary if procurement requires separation during the test. Irene, can you add any infra/ops checks you'd like to run during the canary?

Looking forward — talk at 15:00 PST.
